detail.longDescription:
Meet Beside, the work number that works for you

Beside remembers all your texts & calls and outlines your next steps.

Beside IS YOUR NEW WORK NUMBER
Beside lets you choose a new business phone number in your local area code, so you can enhance your professional brand and separate your work and personal life.

Beside REMEMBERS EVERYTHING
Beside automatically transcribes all your calls and voicemails. Ask Beside AI to retrieve a detail and receive an answer in seconds, without keywords or scrolling.

Beside KNOWS WHAT TO DO NEXT
After every call, Beside automatically sends summaries with suggested actions and calendar events. Plus Beside’s daily recaps mean you’ll never worry about missing something that needs your attention.

**********
Why choose Beside?

LESS ADMIN, MORE PRODUCTIVITY
Beside automatically takes notes and helps you follow up on calls and messages, so you do less admin work and spend more time on what really matters.

LESS STRESS, MORE FOCUS
With Beside as your assistant, you can stop multitasking during calls, and have more energy to focus without distraction. 

NEVER MISS OUT
Beside reminds you about every call and conversation, so you never miss something that needs your attention.

DISCOVER NEW OPPORTUNITIES
Beside can connect the dots across conversations, helping you discover new opportunities for your company, your clients, or your business relationships. 

**********
Who is Beside made for?

REAL ESTATE AGENTS + SALESPEOPLE
Keep better track of listings, offers, clients preferences, contract negotiations, and more. 

BUSINESS OWNERS + ENTREPRENEURS
For anyone running a business that depends on phone calls, Beside makes managing a heavy call load so much simpler.

FREELANCERS + CONSULTANTS
When you’ve got clients and companies who need to reach you, Beside has you covered.

ANYONE WITHS LOTS OF CALLS AND A BUSY SCHEDULE
Beside is flexible enough to assist CEOs, executives, parents, and more.   

**********

Try for free for 7 days, then $29.99 monthly or $199.99 yearly subscription.

By subscribing to Beside, you unlock all features: · Unlimited calls and texts to +1 numbers and other Beside users. · Transcription and summarization of calls and voice notes. · Ask Beside anything, from retrieving info to drafting texts.
